title: PID with anti-windup clamp
prompt: Implement `pid_aw(kp, ki, kd, setpoint, n_steps, dt=0.05, umin=-1, umax=1)` like simulate_pid but freeze integral when u would saturate (conditional integration). Plant dx/dt=-x+u. Return x trajectory list.
public_tests_hint:
- length n_steps
- stays finite
- with high ki still settles near setpoint better than windup-prone case on public params
test_source:
import math
import solution

def run():
    traj=solution.pid_aw(3.0, 8.0, 0.0, 1.0, 200, dt=0.02, umin=-1, umax=1)
    assert len(traj)==200
    assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in traj)
    assert abs(traj[-1]-1.0)<0.25
